blocks.text: Filter pump ke beech mein constriction (tang jagah) hoti hai, is liye nal se aane wala pani ka jet wahan tez behta hai. Is se wahan pressure gir jata hai aur side tube se hawa andar aa jati hai. Hawa aur pani mil kar pump ke neeche wale hisse se bahar nikal jate hain.

blocks.alt: Filter pump ka andarooni drawing. Pani oopar ki tube (Water) se aata hai aur tang nozzle se tez, patli, lehrati dhaar ban kar pump ke beech mein neeche jata aur neeche ke munh se nikalta hai. Daen taraf side tube (Air flow) par teer hawa ko dhaar ki taraf andar aata dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.19: Turbulent flow (filter pump) (kitab ki Figure 5.19 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Fig. 5.19 ka caption bhi ‘Turbulent flow’ likha hai, lekin yeh filter pump ki tasveer hai: constriction par tez jet pressure kam karta hai aur side tube se hawa kheench leta hai.
